job.theme: a monsoon trek in the Western Ghats
job.style: a passage rich in numbers, dates or measurements

response.passage: Last July, our trekking group of 12 students led by Mr. Rao set out to explore the Western Ghats during the peak monsoon. We reached the base camp at Amboli at 6:00 AM on July 14th. The dense mist made the trail slippery, forcing us to move slowly. Because the heavy rains caused the soil to loosen, we had to abandon our plan to climb the highest peak, Kalsubai. Instead, we trekked 8 kilometers toward the Mahabaleshwar ridge. Mr. Rao explained that the moisture-laden winds from the Arabian Sea bring the heavy rainfall to these hills. By 4:00 PM, we reached the shelter, exhausted but happy. While some students wanted to continue, the safety guidelines strictly prohibited trekking after sunset. The trek taught us that nature demands respect, especially when the weather turns unpredictable in these ancient mountains.
response.summary: A group of students led by Mr. Rao attempted a monsoon trek in the Western Ghats. Due to heavy rain and safety concerns, they shortened their route to the Mahabaleshwar ridge. The experience highlighted the importance of respecting nature's unpredictability.
